common_purge: For each split, every training label must end strictly before the first validation/test date. Validation labels must end before the validation window end.
selection: Lowest pooled out-of-sample MSE across the three pre-2024 validation windows; deterministic grid-order tie break.
final_models: Frozen after training on the common purged pre-2024 sample; no test-period refitting or retuning.
forecast_benchmark: Constant mean target estimated on the same purged final training sample. Zero-return metrics also saved as a sensitivity.
portfolio: Signal on first trading day of each month; execute at next trading day adjusted close. Select top 10, clip predicted returns below zero and normalize; equal weight if all 10 are nonpositive. Both models use the same rule. Hold until next monthly execution. Use only completed monthly holding intervals.
portfolio_benchmarks: All 95 equities equal weighted, monthly rebalanced
transaction_cost_details: Solve post-trade wealth + c*sum(abs(target_dollar_positions - pretrade_dollar_positions)) = pretrade_wealth. Include initial entry and final liquidation. No taxes, financing or cash interest.
risk_metrics: Daily net returns; Sharpe uses zero risk-free rate and sqrt(252). CAGR uses elapsed calendar years. Max drawdown includes initial capital.
uncertainty: Paired forecast MSE difference, aggregate cross-sectional losses by date, moving-block bootstrap with 20-date blocks, 2000 replications; descriptive conditional on this chosen universe/window.
